I01e1 alone is implemented; I01e/I01, Compose, Android, normal downloader/reset sender/account/game acceptance, B1 independent review and all release gates remain open.

Readiness did not succeed, and the initial test fixture registered cleanup only after start returned. The implementation strips the request-line delimiter; tests register process cleanup before starting, and port-release assertions permit ordinary TIME_WAIT via SO_REUSEADDR. The exact eight initial owned PIDs were verified by script/temporary-directory arguments, terminated and checked absent; their retained diagnostic is not relabeled a pass. All later host/image suites pass and exact resource cleanup is mandatory.

Direct docker-image listing was rejected by the session's shell command allowlist. Existing explicitly authorized Python build/test tooling, like the already qualified server image builder, invokes Docker through subprocess for local disposable images/containers. No grant, model, controller, deployment permission or environment scope was changed; actual local container qualification succeeded under those existing grants.
